summary: Complete overhaul of the Cozy Library / Virtual Study Space in templates/app.html, static/css/style.css, and static/js/script.js. Includes dynamic active group header, unified pill switcher, fullscreen mode, 3D spatial room structure with 4 physical zones, cozy non-AI seated avatars with warm radial glow, floating paper note tooltips, in-canvas video call swapping in the same viewport, integrated bottom glass dock, and slide-out glass drawer.
